Singh is a serial entrepreneur with experience in building 5 companies from scratch.

Rabbitt AI’s platform offers a robust suite of tools, including core generative AI capabilities, custom LLM development, RAG fine-tuning, data-centric AI, MLOps integration, and voice bot AI agents.
It also focuses on providing data annotation services and data curation services in various domains like healthcare, education, marketing, customer relationship management, and much more.

By combining these features, Rabbitt AI enables businesses to create powerful AI solutions tailored to their specific needs by fine-tuning and training open-source LLMs like Llama, Mistral, BLOOM, Falcon, etc., and even provide the deployment and cloud infra support.

Rabbitt AI also plans to launch “Rabbitt Learning” to help developers and CXOs get skilled in Generative AI.

🚀 Bunny - Agentic AI Software Engineer 👩‍💻

Bunny is an advanced AI software engineer that can understand high-level human instructions, break them down into steps, research relevant information, and write code to achieve the given objective. Bunny utilizes large language models, planning and reasoning algorithms, and web browsing abilities to intelligently develop software. Bunny aims to revolutionize the way we build software by providing an AI pair programmer who can take on complex coding tasks with minimal human guidance. Whether you need to create a new feature, fix a bug, or develop an entire project from scratch, bunny is here to assist you.

Bunny is modeled after [Devin](https://www.cognition-labs.com/introducing-devin) by Cognition AI. This project aims to be an open-source alternative to Devin with an "overly ambitious" goal to meet the same score as Devin in the [SWE-bench](https://www.swebench.com/) Benchmarks... and eventually beat it?

Key Features 🤖 Supports **Claude 3** , **GPT-4** , **Gemini** , **Mistral** , **Groq** and **Local LLMs** via [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) . For optimal performance: Use the **Claude 3** family of models. 🧠 Advanced AI planning and reasoning capabilities 🔍 Contextual keyword extraction for focused research 🌐 Seamless web browsing and information gathering 💻 Code writing in multiple programming languages 📊 Dynamic agent state tracking and visualization 💬 Natural language interaction via chat interface 📂 Project-based organization and management 🔌 Extensible architecture for adding new features and integrations
Requirements ```

Install uv - Python Package manager [download](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv) Install bun - JavaScript runtime [download](https://bun.sh/docs/installation) For ollama [ollama setup guide](https://github.com/RabbittAi/bunny/blob/main/docs/Installation/ollama.md) (optinal: if you don't want to use the local models then you can skip this step)

Create a virtual environment and install the required dependencies (you can use any virtual environment manager): ```shell uv venv On macOS and Linux. source .venv/bin/activate On Windows. .venv\Scripts\activate uv pip install -r requirements.txt ``` Install the playwright for browsering capabilities: ```shell playwright install --with-deps # installs browsers in playwright (and their deps) if required ```

Our philosophy is that "in the Gen AI world, Big is no longer Beautiful, rather Small is Soothing". Smaller, custom and industry specific fine tuned models are making more moves than one big model. At Rabbitt AI, we are the advocates of these and helping companies adopt Open Source AI models like LLama, Mistral, Falcon, BLOOM, Gemma etc. Our platform offers a robust suite of tools, including core generative AI capabilities, custom LLM development, RAG fine-tuning, data-centric AI, MLOps integration, and voice bot AI agents, enabling businesses to create powerful AI solutions. excerpts: Rabbitt AI, a generative AI solutions company, founded by Harneet Singh, serial entrepreneur and an IIT Delhi alum, has raised $2.1 million in seed funding.
Rabbitt AI is a leading generative AI platform that empowers businesses to build and deploy sophisticated AI applications.
Singh is a serial entrepreneur with experience in building 5 companies from scratch.
He is also a member of Forbes Business Council, served as an AI consultant with the South Korean Navy.
He serves as an advisor at Delhi University’s Startup Incubation Fund and an official forum member at Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Industry-Academia Partnership Forum.
The round included participation from TC Group and various angel investors from NVIDIA, Meta, and Microsoft.
Rabbitt AI’s platform offers a robust suite of tools, including core generative AI capabilities, custom LLM development, RAG fine-tuning, data-centric AI, MLOps integration, and voice bot AI agents.
It also focuses on providing data annotation services and data curation services in various domains like healthcare, education, marketing, customer relationship management, and much more.

By combining these features, Rabbitt AI enables businesses to create powerful AI solutions tailored to their specific needs by fine-tuning and training open-source LLMs like Llama, Mistral, BLOOM, Falcon, etc., and even provide the deployment and cloud infra support.

Rabbitt AI also plans to launch “Rabbitt Learning” to help developers and CXOs get skilled in Generative AI.

excerpts: RabbittAi/bunny Page: GitHub repository URL: https://github.com/RabbittAi/bunny
🚀 Bunny - Agentic AI Software Engineer 👩‍💻

Bunny is an advanced AI software engineer that can understand high-level human instructions, break them down into steps, research relevant information, and write code to achieve the given objective. Bunny utilizes large language models, planning and reasoning algorithms, and web browsing abilities to intelligently develop software. Bunny aims to revolutionize the way we build software by providing an AI pair programmer who can take on complex coding tasks with minimal human guidance. Whether you need to create a new feature, fix a bug, or develop an entire project from scratch, bunny is here to assist you.

Bunny is modeled after [Devin](https://www.cognition-labs.com/introducing-devin) by Cognition AI. This project aims to be an open-source alternative to Devin with an "overly ambitious" goal to meet the same score as Devin in the [SWE-bench](https://www.swebench.com/) Benchmarks... and eventually beat it?

Key Features 🤖 Supports **Claude 3** , **GPT-4** , **Gemini** , **Mistral** , **Groq** and **Local LLMs** via [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) . For optimal performance: Use the **Claude 3** family of models. 🧠 Advanced AI planning and reasoning capabilities 🔍 Contextual keyword extraction for focused research 🌐 Seamless web browsing and information gathering 💻 Code writing in multiple programming languages 📊 Dynamic agent state tracking and visualization 💬 Natural language interaction via chat interface 📂 Project-based organization and management 🔌 Extensible architecture for adding new features and integrations
Requirements ```

Install uv - Python Package manager [download](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv) Install bun - JavaScript runtime [download](https://bun.sh/docs/installation) For ollama [ollama setup guide](https://github.com/RabbittAi/bunny/blob/main/docs/Installation/ollama.md) (optinal: if you don't want to use the local models then you can skip this step)

Create a virtual environment and install the required dependencies (you can use any virtual environment manager): ```shell uv venv On macOS and Linux. source .venv/bin/activate On Windows. .venv\Scripts\activate uv pip install -r requirements.txt ``` Install the playwright for browsering capabilities: ```shell playwright install --with-deps # installs browsers in playwright (and their deps) if required ```

Assessment rationale:
- Completeness: The field_description asks for exhaustive OSINT covering multiple facets about Rabbitt AI and hackathon/public student engagement statements (company identity, founders, what the company does, hackathon partnerships, public statements, tech stack/repos, news coverage) with source URLs for every claim. The provided field_answer focuses mainly on NEXORA'26 details, mentions of other hackathon-related signals (OnSkill, DRIP, Rabbitt Learning), and a high-level assessment about what Rabbitt uses hackathons for. It does not comprehensively address all seven requested aspects, and several aspects (founders, HQ, funding; complete product/tech stack; broad list of news coverage; full public statements) are not fully covered. Therefore, completeness should be false.
- Excerpts support: The excerpts include substantial information about NEXORA'26 (including dates, prize, rounds, and the link to Rabbitt AI MCQ round), and multiple references to DRIP, Rabbitt Learning, Rabbitt Enterprise, and OnSkill. The field_answer references these themes (NEXORA details, Delhi finale, OnSkill invitation, DRIP marketing, Rabbitt Learning show, OSINT limitation). Thus, parts of the field_answer are grounded in the excerpts, so supporting status should be true for the claims that align with excerpts. However, because the answer does not comprehensively cover all required aspects, the overall support is partial rather than complete.

Decision:
- completeness = false
- supported = true

🚀 Bunny - Agentic AI Software Engineer 👩‍💻

Bunny is an advanced AI software engineer that can understand high-level human instructions, break them down into steps, research relevant information, and write code to achieve the given objective. Bunny utilizes large language models, planning and reasoning algorithms, and web browsing abilities to intelligently develop software. Bunny aims to revolutionize the way we build software by providing an AI pair programmer who can take on complex coding tasks with minimal human guidance. Whether you need to create a new feature, fix a bug, or develop an entire project from scratch, bunny is here to assist you.

Bunny is modeled after [Devin](https://www.cognition-labs.com/introducing-devin) by Cognition AI. This project aims to be an open-source alternative to Devin with an "overly ambitious" goal to meet the same score as Devin in the [SWE-bench](https://www.swebench.com/) Benchmarks... and eventually beat it?

Key Features 🤖 Supports **Claude 3** , **GPT-4** , **Gemini** , **Mistral** , **Groq** and **Local LLMs** via [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) . For optimal performance: Use the **Claude 3** family of models. 🧠 Advanced AI planning and reasoning capabilities 🔍 Contextual keyword extraction for focused research 🌐 Seamless web browsing and information gathering 💻 Code writing in multiple programming languages 📊 Dynamic agent state tracking and visualization 💬 Natural language interaction via chat interface 📂 Project-based organization and management 🔌 Extensible architecture for adding new features and integrations
Requirements ```

Install uv - Python Package manager [download](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv) Install bun - JavaScript runtime [download](https://bun.sh/docs/installation) For ollama [ollama setup guide](https://github.com/RabbittAi/bunny/blob/main/docs/Installation/ollama.md) (optinal: if you don't want to use the local models then you can skip this step)

Create a virtual environment and install the required dependencies (you can use any virtual environment manager): ```shell uv venv On macOS and Linux. source .venv/bin/activate On Windows. .venv\Scripts\activate uv pip install -r requirements.txt ``` Install the playwright for browsering capabilities: ```shell playwright install --with-deps # installs browsers in playwright (and their deps) if required ```

The Calories Burnt Prediction project leverages machine learning to estimate the number of calories burned based on user-specific data such as gender, age, height, weight, duration of activity, and heart rate. Built using Python and key data science libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn, this model helps in making personalized fitness insights more accessible. It demonstrates a clean pipeline from data preprocessing to model training, evaluation, and prediction—making it a great starting point for anyone interested in health-focused ML applications.

Built using machine learning techniques, this system analyzes patterns in written language to distinguish between genuine and sarcastic statements. Leveraging datasets with labeled sarcastic and non-sarcastic examples, the model learns to understand the subtle cues, tone, and context that often accompany sarcasm. This tool is valuable for applications such as sentiment analysis, customer feedback analysis, and social media monitoring, where sarcasm can obscure the true sentiment of a message.

Singh is a serial entrepreneur with experience in building 5 companies from scratch.
He is also a member of Forbes Business Council, served as an AI consultant with the South Korean Navy.
He serves as an advisor at Delhi University’s Startup Incubation Fund and an official forum member at Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Industry-Academia Partnership Forum.
The round included participation from TC Group and various angel investors from NVIDIA, Meta, and Microsoft.
Rabbitt AI’s platform offers a robust suite of tools, including core generative AI capabilities, custom LLM development, RAG fine-tuning, data-centric AI, MLOps integration, and voice bot AI agents.

🚀 Bunny - Agentic AI Software Engineer 👩‍💻

Bunny is an advanced AI software engineer that can understand high-level human instructions, break them down into steps, research relevant information, and write code to achieve the given objective. Bunny utilizes large language models, planning and reasoning algorithms, and web browsing abilities to intelligently develop software. Bunny aims to revolutionize the way we build software by providing an AI pair programmer who can take on complex coding tasks with minimal human guidance. Whether you need to create a new feature, fix a bug, or develop an entire project from scratch, bunny is here to assist you.

Bunny is modeled after [Devin](https://www.cognition-labs.com/introducing-devin) by Cognition AI. This project aims to be an open-source alternative to Devin with an "overly ambitious" goal to meet the same score as Devin in the [SWE-bench](https://www.swebench.com/) Benchmarks... and eventually beat it?

Key Features 🤖 Supports **Claude 3** , **GPT-4** , **Gemini** , **Mistral** , **Groq** and **Local LLMs** via [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) . For optimal performance: Use the **Claude 3** family of models. 🧠 Advanced AI planning and reasoning capabilities 🔍 Contextual keyword extraction for focused research 🌐 Seamless web browsing and information gathering 💻 Code writing in multiple programming languages 📊 Dynamic agent state tracking and visualization 💬 Natural language interaction via chat interface 📂 Project-based organization and management 🔌 Extensible architecture for adding new features and integrations
Requirements ```

Create a virtual environment and install the required dependencies (you can use any virtual environment manager): ```shell uv venv On macOS and Linux. source .venv/bin/activate On Windows. .venv\Scripts\activate uv pip install -r requirements.txt ``` Install the playwright for browsering capabilities: ```shell playwright install --with-deps # installs browsers in playwright (and their deps) if required ```
